svg.title: Okanagan Similkameen Health Region — logo, traced vector
svg.desc: A vector reconstruction traced with Potrace (corner threshold 1.0, curve optimization 0.2, specks under 2 px dropped) from a supplied 600 by 490 pixel black-and-white GIF of the logo (kept beside this file), not original artwork. The design is the one on the cover of the region's June 1999 health services plan. Traced outlines overlap the GIF's ink 98 percent at its own size; the difference is the GIF's stair-stepped edges. No fonts, rasters or external resources.
